# Alpenlume

> Small iPhone, iPad and Mac apps that each do one thing, with no account, no ads, no tracking and no server: everything stays on the device.

## Apps on sale

- [Talkquote](https://alpenlume.github.io/talkquote.html): Quotations by voice
- [Voucherlume](https://alpenlume.github.io/voucherlume.html): Every card, one wallet
- [Photolume Studio](https://alpenlume.github.io/filmlume.html): Pro photo editor for iPhone and iPad
- [Photolume Mac Studio](https://alpenlume.github.io/filmlume-studio.html): the Mac app of the same purchase

Support: alpenlume@gmail.com
Prices are shown in the App Store, in the buyer's currency.
